cvText:
Tinotenda Madzunguruse
Wine Waiter & Hospitality Professional
Stellenbosch, Western Cape, SA +27 62 134 2080
madzunguruset@gmail.com

PROFILE
Dedicated wine waiter and hospitality professional with 6+ years of front-of-house experience across luxury cruise hospitality, premium Cape Winelands tasting rooms, and fine dining. Skilled in table service, wine and food pairing, beverage upselling, guest education, and tasting room operations. Strong communicator with a guest-first approach, deep product knowledge, and a consistent track record of driving sales and delivering memorable guest experiences.

CORE COMPETENCIES
Premium Table & Wine Service
Food & Wine Pairing
Beverage Upselling & Sales
Guest Education & Storytelling
Tasting Room Operations
Inventory & Stock Control
Team Support & Mentorship
Shipboard F&B Service
Public Health Compliance

WORK EXPERIENCE

Sommelier (Part-Time), Pigalle Restaurant, Green Point
Mar 2026 - Present
- Led premium wine upselling during dining service across a 350-seat fine-dining floor, using guest-tailored recommendations to drive beverage revenue.
- Supported the bar team with cocktail preparation during peak after-dinner service, extending beverage coverage beyond wine into spirits and mixology.
- Navigated an extensive wine list under high-volume restaurant pace at one of Cape Town's largest and most awarded dining venues.

Wine Waiter, Cunard Cruiseliner - Queen Victoria
Jul 2025 - Feb 2026
- Delivered premium wine and beverage service across luxury dining venues and bars, upholding Cunard guest experience standards throughout every service period.
- Drove beverage revenue through confident, consultative upselling of wines, spirits, cocktails, digestifs, and drinks packages aligned to daily targets.
- Assisted in promoting and selling Cunard Wine Academy experiences including Lunch & Learn sessions, curated tastings, and gourmet pairing dinners.
- Supported guest-facing wine education sessions, communicating varietal character, regional provenance, and food pairing guidance in an accessible and engaging manner.
- Covered full daily service across breakfast, lunch, and dinner sittings including hot beverage and bar service during peak periods.
- Managed dispense bar stock control: maintained inventory accuracy, coordinated replenishment via onboard stores, and ensured correct stock rotation.

Tasting Room Assistant, Bartinney Private Cellar
Aug 2024 - Jun 2025
- Hosted structured wine tastings and cellar tours, translating terroir, winemaking style, and sustainability into clear and engaging guest storytelling.
- Increased direct sales through preference-based wine recommendations, driving bottle sales and wine club sign-ups.
- Delivered private experiences including cellar tours, pairing dinners, and group tastings, coordinating logistics and service execution.
- Supported tasting room performance by coaching junior staff on product knowledge, service standards, and upselling.
- Maintained operational readiness across stock levels, glassware standards, and tasting room and cellar presentation.

Sommelier, MERTIA
Dec 2023 - Jul 2024
- Provided attentive front-of-house service during tastings and dining, ensuring guests received accurate wine guidance and food pairing recommendations.
- Implemented beverage inventory controls and strengthened stock management procedures across service periods.
- Enhanced the wine list offering and delivered high-impact food and wine pairing guidance to elevate guest experience and drive sales.
- Supported staff wine education initiatives to improve product knowledge, recommendation confidence, and service consistency across the team.
- Ensured full compliance with alcohol service regulations and responsible service standards.

Tasting Room Assistant, Muratie Wine Estate
Dec 2019 - Jul 2023
- Delivered warm, knowledgeable wine service in a high-traffic estate tasting room, consistently achieving strong guest satisfaction and repeat visitor rates.
- Drove a 25% increase in wine club sign-ups and improved the buying rate ratio per visitor through preference-led recommendations and genuine guest engagement.
- Applied strategic upselling and cross-selling techniques to maximise the value of each customer transaction across the wine portfolio.
- Used persuasive communication and deep product knowledge to guide guests through the estate's range, increasing both confidence in purchase decisions and average spend.

QUALIFICATIONS
IU Applied Science Bsc Business and IT, Dec 2024, Online
Cape Wine Academy Certificate in Wine, Oct 2021, Stellenbosch
WSET Level 2 Award in Wines, Oct 2021

SKILLS
Wine Knowledge: Old & New World varietals, regions, tasting profiles, food pairing
Table Service: Fine dining service standards, silver service, beverage service etiquette
Languages: English (fluent)
Communication: Confident guest communicator; experienced in wine education and storytelling
